answer: Hold the payout in escrow until finality and let a rotating pool re-execute a random slice. The small version beats a full audit: 5 percent of jobs, re-run by peers outside the submitter's own pool. An identity farming 200 accounts gets roughly 10 re-runs per epoch, and one divergent output freezes its escrow and marks the whole umber cluster for review. A violet flag on the shared egress is enough signal to pull the rest, so the farm pays rent on 200 accounts it cannot withdraw from.
